summary: Other aliases: destructive, hidden, retry/never, gather_facts/yes and gather_facts/no.
questions: How do I mark an integration test as destructive?
How do I turn off fact gathering for an integration target?

answer_card.title: Miscellaneous aliases
answer_card.answer_md:
- `destructive`: needs `--allow-destructive` outside `--docker`/`--remote`
- `hidden`: ignored, usable as a dependency (automatic for `setup_`/`prepare_` targets)
- `retry/never`: excluded from `--retry-on-error`
- `gather_facts/yes` (default) / `gather_facts/no`
